PolInt. Design fieldbook
Tamil Nadu · India
Research edition / 16 October 2026

Tamil Nadu.
In its own voice.

An editorial direction for a political intelligence app: Tamil that reads comfortably, public evidence that can be checked, and a visual character rooted in the place it serves.

Recommended: Newsprint & Kumkum. Warm paper, charcoal type, a sparing brick-red accent, Noto Sans Tamil for Tamil and Georgia for English headlines. Reserve party colors for labelled data.

செய்தி · சான்று · தெளிவு

10 rulesTheme & type labProduct researchIndian reader contextMotifsPolitical neutralityScreenshot auditAccessibilitySources

Evidence & scope. Reviewed all ten supplied PolInt screenshots. Compared public publisher sites, official product writing, app listings and standards; this is not a hands-on audit of every installed app. “Observed” refers to public surfaces; “recommendation” is a design inference. National reports are context, not a representative study of PolInt’s Tamil Nadu audience. All illustrative headlines, profile details and seat totals below are fictional. Source links need a connection; the fieldbook, images and embedded font tests work offline.

01

Ten rules to build by

Make the first screen feel like a useful Tamil Nadu publication. Cultural references should support the reading experience; evidence and language do most of the work.

Put the first story above the statistics.

Replace the feed’s four archive counters with one quiet archive link. Lead with a headline, place, publisher and publication time. Editorial sectioning and short summaries give people a reading path; a source inventory does not.

Basis: Dinamani’s section structure; Inshorts’ concise reading model. Placement is our recommendation.

Give Tamil a first-class reading system.

Start body copy at 18px / 1.8 for Tamil and 17–18px / 1.6–1.8 for English. Use Noto Sans Tamil, normal letter spacing, natural wrapping, and no fixed-height headline boxes. Tune these starting values with readers; retain the original source language.

Basis: W3C Tamil script resources (draft); Noto Sans Tamil.

Offer Tamil / English without hiding source language.

Make language choice visible and remember it. Distinguish interface language, article language and translated summaries; label translation. Search Tamil names, accepted English spellings and constituency aliases.

Basis: IAMAI–Kantar 2024 language findings; Dailyhunt language control. Alias search is a PolInt recommendation.

Use paper and ink; let dark mode be a choice.

Trial a warm light default, dark option and system setting. Use dark charcoal, clear rules and one restrained accent. Verify each mode separately. Light-first is a hypothesis for reading and outdoor use, not a demonstrated nationwide preference.

Basis: PhonePe’s accessible dark-theme process; Dailyhunt’s system/dark options.

Make provenance more prominent than badges.

Show publisher, original link, published/collected times and evidence type. “Official ECI result”, “Self-declared affidavit” and “Unverified social claim” describe different things. A green tick cannot stand in for that distinction.

Basis: ADR’s affidavit-based MyNeta; DigiLocker’s issued-document provenance.

Keep political color inside political data.

Use neutral navigation, buttons and profile shells. Party dots, legends and seat marks may carry color with names and counts. Give every party equal treatment; support patterns/labels and a neutral chart mode.

Basis: DMK’s official identity; BJP flag specification; WCAG use of color. Neutral-shell policy is our recommendation.

Design for an ordinary Android phone.

Start at 360–412 CSS pixels, then reflow at 320. Aim for 48px primary touch targets; keep labels visible. Use text-first lists, deferred images and a clear cached-data timestamp. Test a low/mid-range handset and unreliable connectivity before release.

Basis: Statcounter’s Android-heavy usage sample; WCAG reflow. Device test sizes and budgets are proposed acceptance targets.

Speak in local numbers and explicit dates.

Use en-IN grouping: 2,34,000; ₹8.9 crore with an exact amount available. Use DD/MM/YYYY in compact views and “16 Oct 2026, 14:35 IST” in evidence details. Include an absolute time beside “5 minutes ago”; never substitute scrape time for event date.

Basis: Intl number formatting; Intl date/time formatting. These are product conventions, not universal legal requirements.

Share the evidence with the headline.

Offer the Android share sheet plus copy text/link. A WhatsApp-ready excerpt should keep the source URL, date and verification status in the message. Share in the article’s language; label translations. Avoid image-only evidence that loses links.

Basis: Reuters Institute’s India news context; Web Share API. The report’s online sample does not establish every Tamil reader’s habits.

Use one Tamil detail, and meet the access baseline.

A small kolam divider or textile double rule is enough. Remove decorative gradients and repeated colored rails. Keep a clear heading hierarchy, visible focus, TalkBack-ready labels and tested contrast; use WCAG 2.2 AA as the product target.

Basis: D’Source’s kolam documentation; UX4G foundations; WCAG 2.2.
02

A palette is a reading decision.

Three material references, each with independently defined light and dark tokens. Switching changes the phone, type specimen and live audit. The fieldbook itself stays on paper so comparisons remain stable.

Choose a direction
Newsprint & Kumkum / light
Paper, charcoal and a small kumkum accent. Editorial rather than ceremonial.

Inspect the tokens

Each swatch compares the selected primary text and secondary text against that fill. Low ratios on accent/decorative fills mean those text colors must not be used there. The pair audit below tests how the mockup actually uses them.

Calculated from sRGB relative luminance: (Llighter + 0.05) / (Ldarker + 0.05). The unrounded ratio determines the pass label. Normal text ≥ 4.5:1; large text ≥ 3:1. These swatches are a text audit, not a full accessibility certification.

Pairs used in the preview

Decorative gold is never body text or a state indicator. The neutral seat strip has a text legend. Control outlines and focus need ≥ 3:1 where required; decorative dividers do not carry meaning.

Test Tamil and English together

தமிழ்நாட்டின் அரசியல் செய்திகள் — தெளிவாக, சான்றுகளுடன்.

கல்வி, குடிநீர், போக்குவரத்து: திட்டங்கள் மக்களின் வாழ்க்கையை எவ்வாறு மாற்றுகின்றன? ஸ்ரீவில்லிபுத்தூர் · காஞ்சிபுரம் · விழுப்புரம்

Follow the evidence. Read the source. ₹8.9 crore · 2,34,000 residents · 234 constituencies.

தமிழ் + English: ₹8.9 கோடி · 16/10/2026 · 14:35 IST

Noto Sans Tamil: neutral body copy; Georgia gives English headlines an editorial voice.

Five Tamil families are embedded under the SIL Open Font License; English uses installed Georgia/Arial or their system fallbacks. Font tests work offline. Production: package one chosen Tamil family locally, set lang="ta", avoid letter spacing on Tamil, and let text containers grow.

Read before choosing

  • Newsprint: strongest fit for reporting and source-led reading. Red has party associations too: keep it small and never pair it as a red/black party banner.
  • Temple Stone: an archive/material direction, not a religious identity. Use stone and bronze tones; omit deities and temple silhouettes from everyday controls.
  • Kolam Night: a low-glare alternative with warm text. Its green must remain distinct from party data colors; offer it by preference, not as “the Indian dark mode”.

03

Learn the grammar, not the branding.

Indian products solve different jobs. A premium credit-card app and a Tamil daily do not prove the same reading needs. The useful common thread is legible hierarchy, familiar tasks, locality and visible outcomes. The “apply” column is our interpretation, not a claim about each company’s internal rationale.

What Indian design studios add

LOCAL describes multilingual logo adaptation and culturally nuanced work with local writers and researchers. WhiteCrow builds custom Indic type across scripts. Ek Type’s Anek gives multiple Indian scripts their own typographic voice within one family. The inference for PolInt: commission good Tamil wording, test glyphs and keep the composition intentional. There is no single pan-Indian UI style to copy.

04

The reader’s conditions come first.

Android is the starting point.

Statcounter reports Android at 93.89% of its Indian mobile OS usage sample in September 2026. This measures tracked browsing, not handset ownership or the low-end device share. It supports Android-first checks, not a claim that all readers have slow phones. Source.

Proposed test matrix: 320, 360 and 412 CSS px; 1440px desktop; a 3–4GB RAM Android device; system text at 200%; TalkBack; patchy 4G; bright outdoor light. Make the first story accessible without downloading a chart or portrait. Reserve photo dimensions and defer nonessential media.

Cheap data is not reliable delivery.

TRAI’s FY2025–26 release gives average wireless data revenue realization of ₹8.02/GB, down from ₹8.97. That is an industry average, not a universal prepaid tariff or proof that everyone can afford repeated downloads. TRAI release via PIB.

Recommendation: text-first initial view; cached stories with “Saved at 14:35 IST”; manual refresh that retains the scroll position; no autoplay or decorative video. Establish a byte budget from the real payload and measure on representative hardware. Connectivity and responsiveness still matter.

Tamil is not a translation afterthought.

IAMAI–Kantar’s Internet in India 2024 reports 870 million people accessed Indic-language internet content that year; 57% of urban internet users preferred it. Tamil is among its high-conversion languages. The study concerns internet activity broadly, not specifically political-news reading. Report, language section.

Use lang="ta" and a Tamil-capable family; Latin and Tamil need separate optical size checks. Begin at 1.8 Tamil line height; inspect vowel signs, pulli, numerals, bold text and wrapping in long place names. Avoid tracking and condensed forced widths. Preserve Tamil originals alongside labelled translations. W3C script resources (work in progress).

Familiar formats reduce friction.

2,34,000₹8.9 crore16/10/202614:35 IST

Format counts with Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN'). For money use INR, then an explicit lakh/crore presentation rule; do not rely on English compact notation to always produce the intended Indian unit. ₹8.9 crore equals ₹8,90,00,000; make the exact figure available in evidence views.

Use the IANA zone Asia/Kolkata for timestamps; write IST visibly because browser abbreviations vary. Display an unambiguous month name in exports and evidence details. Keep event date, source publication and collection time as separate fields. NumberFormat / DateTimeFormat.

Trust has to survive forwarding.

The Reuters Institute’s 2025 India chapter covers a social/video-heavy news environment and WhatsApp use, while warning that its mainly English-speaking online sample is only part of India. Treat forwarding as an important scenario to test with Tamil readers, not a national stereotype. Study and sample limitations.

Offer Android’s share sheet and copy link/text. Include headline, publisher, date, original URL and “unverified” where applicable. A good preview should not turn an allegation into a fact. In Capacitor, verify the native share integration and fallback behavior; a browser’s Web Share API has platform and secure-context requirements.

Light and dark are user choices.

No representative Tamil Nadu light/dark preference study was established in this research. PhonePe documents testing a dark theme; Dailyhunt exposes a system option. Neither proves a universal preference. PhonePe / Dailyhunt.

Trial warm light for the editorial direction; support system preference and an explicit override. Test text and secondary labels outdoors on a modest display. Avoid low-contrast grey-on-navy and pure-white glare. Ask Tamil/English readers to find a source, compare an MLA record and inspect a seat; measure task completion, comprehension and errors.

05

A sense of place, at the margin.

These are newly drawn geometric studies, not reproductions of sacred designs. Use a small divider, a border rhythm or a material tone. Keep religion, caste and party imagery out of the neutral product shell.

Kolam line

Do: one 1–1.5px interlaced divider at a chapter break, clear of text. Decorative SVGs should be hidden from assistive technology in production.

Don’t: tile behind articles, animate continuously or call every looping pattern an authentic ritual kolam. Cultural context: D’Source.

Silk-border rhythm

Do: borrow the idea of a narrow contrast border and repeated geometry from Kanjeevaram weaving. A double rule can organize a masthead without becoming decoration everywhere.

Don’t: add metallic gradients, ornate sari textures behind data or generic “ethnic” trim to every card. Kancheepuram district’s silk documentation.

Stone & stepped geometry

Do: abstract a rhythm of tiers into an occasional divider; use sandstone, granite and aged-bronze tones as material references.

Don’t: use a gopuram or deity as the app’s universal “Tamil” icon. Chola bronzes carry religious meaning: borrow a patina tone, not an idol as decoration. Temple context / Tamil Nadu Archaeology.

Kumkum / brick redHaldi / muted turmericNeel / indigoPeacock tealTemple stoneNewsprint

These names are creative material associations, not a standardized “Indian palette” or universal meanings. Kumkum and haldi have ritual contexts; green and saffron also carry political/religious associations. Test interpretation across Tamil Nadu communities. Indian textile/color history is diverse; Kanchipuram’s craft context supports the material reference, not these exact hex codes.

Tamil newspaper identity can live in the masthead, the language, a strong lead story and a fine rule. It does not need a decorative frame around every fact.

06

No party owns the interface.

Color neutrality is a policy, not a magic hue. DMK’s red/black, AIADMK’s black/white/red identity and green chart mark in the supplied PolInt screenshot, BJP’s saffron/green, INC’s tricolor, TVK’s red/yellow and NTK’s red/yellow imagery overlap. No single color uniquely identifies a party. Chart colors are approximations, not ECI-prescribed standards.

Use neutral surfaces, typography and actions across every dossier. Keep party identity to a small mark and written name; apply the same size, evidence fields, sorting rule and visibility to all parties. Never recolor the whole app to match the selected politician.

In assembly charts, name the party and print the count. Offer a neutral alternative and a table/list fallback. Separate party affiliation from alliance, ruling/opposition role and case status. Keep a dated color mapping; do not use red for allegations when red also means a party.

Primary identity references: DMK; BJP flag; INC’s tricolor; NTK. AIADMK’s flag is specified in its party by-laws; TVK’s red/yellow flag is documented in Indian Express reporting of its launch (secondary source). The proposed UI mappings below are deliberately not official party colors.

Avoid a full saffron/green or tricolor shell: it may imply a national-party or official-government identity. A small kumkum accent also needs perception testing because of red/black associations. Political fairness additionally depends on sourcing, ranking, labels and corrections.

Identity without a campaign poster

Same neutral rows. Toggle only the small data mark. No live results or seat counts are shown.

Neutral: initials and names identify each party. The shell stays unchanged.

Assembly summary in the phone uses filled, hatched and outlined segments plus counts. A full 234-seat chamber also needs keyboard-operable selection and a constituency list; tiny colored seat dots cannot be the only interaction.

07

What to take out. What to put back.

Specific findings from the supplied screenshots, not a general diagnosis of AI authorship. Check items as an implementation review aid; the checklist resets when this file reloads.

Open the ten original screenshot references (embedded for offline review)
08

Accessibility is part of the visual language.

GIGW 3.0

GIGW’s scope is government-owned websites and apps; its accessibility baseline is WCAG 2.1 AA. PolInt is not made government-compliant by adopting a government design system. Use GIGW’s ownership, content quality, mobile access and lifecycle practices as a civic-product benchmark. Scope / Focus areas.

WCAG 2.2 AA

Set the product target at 2.2 AA. Normal text ≥4.5:1; large text ≥3:1; required UI boundaries/focus cues ≥3:1. Support keyboard use, visible/unobscured focus, 200% text and 320px reflow. AA target-size minimum is 24×24 CSS px with exceptions; PolInt should aim for 48px primary controls. W3C Recommendation.

RPwD Act, 2016

Sections 40, 42 and 46 address accessibility standards, accessible ICT/information, and service-provider accessibility. This makes accessibility relevant beyond government styling. Determine applicability to PolInt’s service and delivery arrangements before making a compliance claim. India Code: statute and sections.

IS 17802

BIS’s IS 17802 Part 1:2021 covers ICT accessibility requirements; Part 2:2022 covers determination of conformance. DEPwD lists the ICT standards notification dated 11 June 2023. India’s standards/rules work continued following Rajive Raturi; do not equate passing a web contrast test with statutory or BIS conformance. Notification register / ICT standards / 2025 rule-making context.

Release checks for the actual app

TalkBack reads Tamil and English with language metadata; all tabs, filters and seats have meaningful names; seat data has a list/table alternative; no outcome relies on color alone; content survives 200% text and WCAG text-spacing overrides; focus stays visible above bottom navigation; controls remain reachable with a keyboard; motion respects reduced-motion; cached/refresh/error status is announced without moving focus. Test the Android WebView and screen reader on a real device. This fieldbook’s browser checks do not establish the app’s conformance.

Upstream distribution & license

Verification record & research limitations

Verified in headless Chromium with Playwright 1.64.1: 412px and 1440px layouts; all three themes in both modes; five offline Tamil font pairings; type-size/line-height extremes; keyboard toggle activation; share preview; party-color switch; screenshot gallery; source-ledger coverage and internal anchors. Additional 320px reflow and 200% root-text checks passed. No console/page errors, external resource requests or horizontal overflow were found. All nine used token pairs pass their stated text/control contrast thresholds in all six theme/mode combinations. Screenshots: /tmp/india-ui/research-412.png and research-1440.png, with overview/workbench/phone detail captures alongside them. Real-device TalkBack and outdoor readability remain app implementation checks.

Visual review: all ten supplied screenshots, five desktop and five mobile. Competitive research is based on public pages, official product writing and publisher listings, not a representative user study or exhaustive installed-app comparison. The Hindu homepage was restricted; its publisher listing was used. Zepto’s website returned HTTP 403; its publisher listing was used. Font specimen pages are JavaScript-driven; upstream font metadata/licenses support the embedded type specimens. Suggested palette names and hex values are design proposals.

No evidence established a universal Indian preference for colorful interfaces, light mode, low-priced devices or WhatsApp-only sharing. Validate these proposals with Tamil/English readers across age, device quality and accessibility needs before committing the app redesign.

PolInt · Independent political information, designed around evidence.மொழியில் நெருக்கம். தகவலில் தெளிவு.
